authorial_core.baseline_prompt_en: Make an analog-horror photograph of a woman drawn from the supplied portrait, encountering an unsettling recorded event in her own sitting room. Use the supplied portrait as appearance guidance for her face and hair: a short dark bob, fine loose bangs, dark eyes, and the visible facial proportions. She sits on the worn rug at the left of a low television stand, wearing a soft charcoal sleeveless home top and loose cream trousers. Her knees are folded to one side, her left palm resting on the rug beside her hip; her right hand loosely holds a squared plastic remote above her lap. Blue screen light grazes her cheek and softly parted lips. Her quiet attractiveness remains subordinate to a precise, uneasy realization. A boxy CRT television and VHS deck occupy the center foreground. The curved screen shows a paused, low-resolution personal camcorder recording of this same sitting room. In that recording, an unfamiliar pale-faced person in an ordinary dark coat sits bolt upright in a mustard-yellow armchair, looking directly into the recording lens. The high narrow chair back has a conspicuous diagonal repaired seam. In the real room behind and to the right of the television, the identical mustard chair with that repaired seam is visibly empty; its bare seat and full backrest are unobstructed. The recorded person's fixed forward stare feels intrusive because this is an intimate home recording. Fine horizontal scanlines, mild chroma bleed, a bright tracking tear confined to the screen's lower edge, and a small white pause symbol locate the disturbance inside an analog recording. The woman has begun turning her head from the screen toward the actual empty chair, her eyebrows faintly drawn together, her hand stopped over the remote. An open cassette case lies beside the deck. A weak tungsten table lamp reveals scuffed wallpaper, the empty chair and a closed curtain; the screen supplies the colder light across her face. Photograph one continuous room from a nearby seated observer's height, looking diagonally across her three-quarter face, readable television screen and actual chair. Give the screen roughly a third of the image width and keep the two chair states legible at once. A horizontal 3:2 photograph with restrained grain, realistic interior textures, and enough depth of field to compare the recorded occupant with the present vacancy.
